title: Offline-first sync for field technicians on poor networks
tagline: Designed a SQLite + AsyncStorage sync layer with custom retry queues and exponential backoff, lifting sync success in low-connectivity areas from ~30% to ~80%.
seoDescription: Designed a SQLite + AsyncStorage sync layer with custom retry queues and exponential backoff, lifting sync success in low-connectivity areas from ~30% to ~80%.
context: A suite of 4+ production React Native apps used by 2,000+ field technicians, often working in low-connectivity areas.

metrics.label: Sync success in low-connectivity areas
metrics.srText: sync success in low-connectivity areas rose from about 30% to about 80%

challenge: Field technicians work in low-connectivity areas, where only about 30% of syncs succeeded. The apps had to keep working offline and reliably catch up whenever a connection returned.

approach.title: Store data on the device first
approach.text: Designed an offline-first architecture on local storage, using SQLite and AsyncStorage.

approach.title: Retry with exponential backoff
approach.text: Built custom retry queues with exponential backoff so that failed syncs are retried.

approach.title: Manage state across the suite
approach.text: Used Redux Toolkit to manage state across the app suite.

outcome: Sync success in low-connectivity areas rose from ~30% to ~80%.
4+ production apps in use by 2,000+ field technicians.

alsoShipped.title: Alongside the sync work
items: −60% image payloads, through automated media compression
−30% UI latency, by refactoring legacy components
15+ Android and iOS releases through App Store and Play Store review cycles, including encrypted local storage and compliance checks
